Chapter 1103: 26: Not A Big Problem (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1103: Chapter 26: Not a Big Problem (Seeking Subscription)

“Galaxy?”

The numerous Great Venerables on the scene glanced at each other.

The title of Great Venerable always carries a specific meaning.

‘Red Leaf’ of the Great Venerate Hongye implies the coexistence of Chaos Flame and Chaos Life.

The ‘Qingfen’ of the Great Venerable Qingfen also, to some extent, reveals the path he has taken.

But as for ‘Galaxy’?

“Galaxy Great Venerable?”

A smile appeared on the face of the Great Venerate Hongye.

He did not ask Lin Yuan why he chose this title.

Every Great Venerable has their own secrets. Since Lin Yuan wishes to use ‘Galaxy’ as his title, he would not inquire further.

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Using ‘Galaxy’ as his title mainly commemorates his life on ‘Earth’ before crossing worlds.

The true form in the Chaos Void, Galaxy Master, Galaxy Supreme, and other names are for the same reason.

As for whether using the title of ‘Galaxy Great Venerable’ would expose his true identity…

The Chaos Void and this source world are not even on the same dimensional plane, and crossing different dimensions is difficult, even for a Thirteenth Layer Time Life.

Moreover, even if one could cross, the words ‘Galaxy’ are much too common.

“I believe the name ‘Galaxy Great Venerable’ will surely resound throughout the nearby Ancient Country domains in the future.”

Great Venerate Hongye said with a smile.

The other Great Venerables were slightly taken aback upon hearing these words.

They could hear that Great Venerate Hongye held Lin Yuan in high regard.

To echo across nearby Ancient Country domains? That requires at least the pinnacle strength of a Great Venerable.

And the pinnacle of Great Venerable? Not every Great Venerable can reach the pinnacle stage.

To many Great Venerables, Lin Yuan was just a newly ascended Great Venerable.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, a few months went by.

With the exchange and spread among nearly twenty Great Venerables, Lin Yuan’s name as ‘Galaxy Great Venerable’ began to spread.

The circles among Great Venerables have their interconnections, and through this war, Lin Yuan managed to make a name for himself.

And with the favor of Great Venerate Hongye and Lord Qingfen, many Great Venerables were especially supportive of Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan was not very concerned about this; even without considering the Divine Skill ‘Fierce Sun Opens the Sky,’ his true combat power was estimated to be close to the peak of a Great Venerable like Hongye.

Moreover, as time passed, Lin Yuan’s combat strength was improving almost every moment.

Yet Lin Yuan had no intention of revealing his full abilities.

Before fully comprehending the Divine Skill imprint of ‘Fierce Sun Opens the Sky,’ it was best to remain low-key and cautious.

…

Inside the City Lord’s Mansion.

Lord Qingfen appeared solemn, and all Great Venerables, including Lin Yuan, gathered here.

“I suppose Marquis Purple Dream over there is preparing to launch an attack.”

Lord Qingfen remarked.

He kept a constant watch on the border battlefield, faintly perceiving the movements of many war machines on the side of the Purple Dream Domain.

“It was bound to happen sooner or later.”

“Let’s see who can break through.”

The Great Venerables were not surprised; with Purple Dream Domain amassing troops at the border, launching an attack at this moment was too normal.

This group of Great Venerables gathered here was precisely for this day.

“Hongye, Fire Axe, your strengths are the greatest. By that time, Great Honored Barbarian Moon and Divine Phoenix Great Honored will be entrusted to you both.”

Lord Qingfen looked towards Great Venerate Hongye and Fire Axe Great Venerable.

These two Great Venerables were friends of Lord Qingfen, invited to help resist the invasion from Purple Dream.

“Rest assured.”

Great Venerate Hongye and Fire Axe Great Venerable nodded.

Great Honored Barbarian Moon and Divine Phoenix Great Honored are top-tier Great Venerables from the Purple Dream Domain, terrifying in strength. On the scene, only Great Venerate Hongye, Fire Axe Great Venerable, and Lord Qingfen could confidently defend against them.

However, Lord Qingfen needs to coordinate at the center and would not join the battlefield unless absolutely necessary, thus relying on Hongye and Fire Axe.

“And everyone, do your best to fend off the opponents. If anything unexpected happens or any uncertain factors arise, inform me immediately.”

Lord Qingfen addressed the other Great Venerables.

For a thousand years, all the Great Venerables had repeatedly simulated potential scenarios of the war and identified who they should confront.

“Galaxy, your opponent is Thunder Spear Great Honored. Do you have confidence?”

Lord Qingfen looked towards Lin Yuan, asking seriously.

Thunder Spear Great Honored, also a newly ascended Great Venerable, crossed into the realm twenty thousand years ago.

For a Great Venerable, twenty thousand years is not long, so Thunder Spear Great Honored is still considered a new Great Venerable.

Lord Qingfen specially assigned one of the weakest opposing Great Venerables for Lin Yuan to deal with.

After all, only Lord Qingfen knew that Lin Yuan had not truly crossed into the Great Venerable realm.

“I have confidence.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“That’s good.”

Lord Qingfen was quite assured in Lin Yuan, as in his eyes, Lin Yuan possessed core royal blood, so even as a mere overlord, he could challenge a Great Venerable to some extent.

Furthermore, Lord Qingfen would constantly watch over Lin Yuan, ready to assist immediately if anything unexpected happened.

“This war must be won.”

Lord Qingfen looked at all the Great Venerables, solemnly stating, “After the victory, Qingfen will have a great reward.”

Once the Qingfen Domain fell, the greatest responsibility would certainly lie with ‘Red Pine King.’

But the greatest loss would naturally be on Lord Qingfen.

After all, the Qingfen Domain was his fief, and its fall would mean the collapse of Lord Qingfen’s years of accumulation in an instant.

It is precisely because of this that during the war preparations, Lord Qingfen made every effort to leverage his connections and invited peak Great Venerables like Great Venerate Hongye and Fire Axe Great Venerable to assist.

In fact, ‘Red Pine King’ also mobilized many Great Venerable-level powerhouses for support.

…

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

A consciousness avatar descended into the inner universe.

Buzz buzz buzz.

Almost every moment, the inner universe underwent transformation, as the Second Layer of “Infinite Void” slowly reformed the inner universe.

During the Path Splitting Realm, Lin Yuan’s inner universe spanned only tens of millions of light-years, while Chaos Venerables had an inner universe of hundreds of billions of light-years.

In terms of sheer size, the difference between the two was immeasurable.

Yet in volume, they were almost equivalent.

Thanks to the empowerment and transformation by “Infinite Void” on the inner universe.

In fact, while cultivating “Infinite Void,” Lin Yuan’s inner universe was constantly shrinking.

However, the rate of shrinkage was less than the rate of expansion, so overall, the inner universe still exhibited an expansion trend.

Now, the diameter of Lin Yuan’s inner universe exceeded tens of billions of light-years, and the power contained could easily crush ordinary Chaos Venerables.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan, while cultivating the Second Layer of “Infinite Void”, suddenly paused as if realizing something.

“Fierce Sun… Heaven Opening!”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred slightly, and a flame suddenly appeared before him.

At this moment, his true essence in the source world focused most of his mental energy on comprehending the Divine Skills imprint of ‘Fierce Sun Heaven Opening.’ Even without full insight, Lin Yuan could partially replicate it.

Of course, it couldn’t be sustained.

“If I use this Divine Skills to empower my inner universe…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes shone brightly.

The Divine Skills ‘Fierce Sun Heaven Opening’ focuses not on destruction, but on ‘Heaven Opening’.

What is Heaven Opening? The creation of heaven and earth.

Why can it create heaven and earth?

The realm covered by the Fierce Sun is the territory, the land.

If an eternal Fierce Sun were to be condensed in the inner universe, illuminating the universe with its radiance, what impact would that have on the inner universe?

Lin Yuan’s inner universe had already cultivated the Thirteenth Tier legacy “Infinite Void,” and if the Fierce Sun Heaven Opening’s abilities, mastered only by Thirteenth Tier temporal beings, were to empower it…

If these two Thirteenth Tier powers could merge together…

Lin Yuan’s heart surged with excitement as he immediately began to attempt.

Due to not fully penetrating the Divine Skills imprint of ‘Fierce Sun Heaven Opening,’ the flames Lin Yuan condensed would not last long.

They would soon extinguish.

But Lin Yuan could still perceive the impact the radiance of Fierce Sun Heaven Opening would exert on the inner universe.

…

Beside the jade gourd.

The red-dressed girl also focused on the changes in the inner universe.

“Eh?”

The red-dressed girl seemed to realize something, showing surprise on her face.

She clearly sensed the slowing transformation speed of Lin Yuan’s inner universe.

This meant that Lin Yuan slowed down his progress in cultivating “Infinite Void.”

This made the red-dressed girl somewhat curious as “Infinite Void” was a Thirteenth Tier legacy, offering extraordinary enhancement to Twelfth Tier beings.

Why did Lin Yuan slow down his cultivation of “Infinite Void” at this time?

…

Purple Dream Domain.

Marquis Purple Dream and numerous Great Venerables were likewise engaged in final war preparations.

“Everyone, once we breach the Qingfen Domain and His Highness the Spirit Might King gains significant prestige, becoming a candidate for the throne, the benefits we gain need no further explanation.”

Marquis Purple Dream’s words were brief, yet stirred the emotions of all the Great Venerables.

As Great Venerables, they naturally understood why the Spirit Might King actively initiated this war.

It was to become the emperor of the Ancient Country.

Only by expanding the territory of the Ancient Country could he gain sufficient prestige and thus become a candidate for the throne.

Being a candidate for the throne means the opportunity to compete for the position of the Ancient Country’s emperor.

If Spirit Might King could finally take that step and become the next emperor of the Ancient Country, with rewards for merit, how could those Great Venerables miss out?

“Now, follow me to the battlefield.”

Marquis Purple Dream, leading numerous Great Venerables, instantly arrived at the border battlefield via the Space-Time Passage.

“His Highness the Spirit Might King is watching this war, so do not withhold your strength,” reminded Marquis Purple Dream.

Whether it was Qingfen Domain or Purple Dream Domain, the true trump cards or strongest forces would undoubtedly observe without entering the fray immediately.

The Spirit Might King needed to make warfare decisions based on the situation.

“According to the planned strategy, proactively confront the designated opponents at that time.”

Marquis Purple Dream began to speak.

Lord Qingfen had already determined many opponents for the Great Venerables, and naturally, the Purple Dream Domain was no exception.

…

“My opponent is… Galaxy Great Venerate? Newly advanced Great Venerate just over a thousand years ago.”

Thunder Spear Great Honored, a thin and old man, ponders carefully at this moment.

On the surface, Thunder Spear Great Honored stepped into the realm of Great Venerate more than two hundred thousand years ago, still considered a newly advanced Great Venerate.

But in reality, Thunder Spear Great Honored entered the Great Venerable realm over a million years ago.

However, he concealed this fact.

“With my current strength, a newly advanced Great Venerate like Galaxy Great Venerate is an easy capture.”

“At that time, I’ll undoubtedly have a chance to shine before His Highness the Spirit Might King.”

Thunder Spear Great Honored knew that Spirit Might King was observing the battlefield. If he performed well, his standing in Spirit Might King’s mind would be different.
